notes.title: (2019/06/04)Release Note ver. 0.4
notes.notes:
New Features

 New difficulty and stage design in STAGE1 and STAGE2.  

----new traps and enemies in hard mode are waiting for you!!!----

 Brightness and Exposure can be adjust in Option Menu.
 4 achievement implements.


Secification Changes

 Damage judgment of player is modified smaller, so normal mode is easier than before.
 While player getting close to enemy bullet, SLOW MOTION will be actived automatically.


Thank you for playing! I wish you can enjoy this game!
